headline: Southern Connecticut hold Franklin Pierce as conference play opens
dek: Southern Connecticut are still without a win, but their third draw in five matches took a point off a Franklin Pierce side that had won its previous two. No member has yet lost at home to another, and Pace and Southern New Hampshire have yet to lose at all.
displaced_by: Conference play opened with Southern Connecticut v Franklin Pierce drawn; the standing dek's four member meetings are now five

pattern.label: signal
pattern.text: Southern New Hampshire's twenty-four goals are spread across at least thirteen scorers, so no single player carries the tallest bar; Pace sit mid-chart on eleven, and the four they have conceded is the smaller figure that explains their unbeaten record.

wire.line: Franklin Pierce were held in the conference opener, and no side has yet lost at home to another member.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Southern Connecticut's draw with Franklin Pierce was their third in five matches, and they remain the only programme without a win.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Franklin Pierce's draw at Southern Connecticut leaves the home side unbeaten in the five meetings between members, three won and two drawn.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Guillermo Rios has scored six goals from fifteen shots for Franklin Pierce.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Cody Holbert has scored eight goals from twenty-nine shots, more goals than any other player listed.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Joe Zweben has made twenty-eight saves, more than any other goalkeeper listed.

last_match.line: Southern Connecticut are still without a win but have now drawn more often than they have lost; Franklin Pierce arrived on back-to-back wins.

next_match.line: Southern New Hampshire have yet to lose and open their conference schedule at home; American International lost their last match without scoring.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
